connector.name: Haunt
connector.registryDescription: Public pages to clean JSON or Markdown, plus bounded site mapping and crawl. Failed calls are free.
connector.summary: Hosted at hauntapi.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace com.hauntapi. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: HAUNT_API_KEY
env.description: Haunt API key from https://hauntapi.com. Required for live extraction; not required for try_demo_extract.
